title: Otter.ai Review (2026)
intro: Otter.ai is evaluated here as AI software — Otter.ai is an AI meeting assistant for live transcription, summaries, and action items with OtterPilot joining Zoom, Meet, and Teams. Basic is free (300 minutes/month, 30-minute conversation cap). Pro is $8.33/user/mo annual or $16.99 monthly (1,200 minutes, 90-minute cap). Business is $19.99/user/mo annual or $30 monthly with much higher/unlimited meeting minutes and admin. Enterprise is contact sales (SSO/SCIM, OtterPilot for Sales). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Otter.ai when AI meeting notes and auto-join transcription are the job — not a general LLM or voice studio.
verdict: Choose Otter.ai when AI meeting notes and auto-join transcription are the job — not a general LLM or voice studio. Compare Microsoft 365 Copilot if Teams recap is already paid for; ChatGPT if you only paste transcripts into a chat. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Calendar auto-join and a simple transcript UI are easy for non-technical users.
Primary job is AI meeting notes — ai-meeting cluster, not ChatGPT or ElevenLabs.
Live transcript + summary/action items are the quality story from vendor packaging.
OtterPilot, shared workspaces, and CRM/Slack hooks add a post-meeting loop.
Zoom, Meet, Teams, Slack, and CRM connectors cover the meeting stack.
Enterprise SSO/SCIM exists; Free/Pro are individual-grade.
Free → Pro → Business → Enterprise is a clear seat ladder.
Annual Pro at $8.33 is a strong individual floor; Business is the team SKU. Affiliate economics excluded.
Meeting-specialist models, not frontier general LLM compute.

notIdealFor: Buyers who need a general LLM (ChatGPT)
cons: Bot-join UX is polarising in some meetings
limitations: Minute and per-conversation caps on Free/Pro burn down in a busy meeting week
